description: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test - For admission to MBBS/BDS courses

sections.name: Section A - Physics
sections.subject: Physics
sections.instructions: This section contains 40 Physics questions. All questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options each, having single correct answer. Each correct answer carries 4 marks and each incorrect answer carries -1 mark. There is no negative marking for unattempted questions.

general_instructions: Total duration of the examination is 180 minutes (3 hours)
The test consists of 200 questions divided into four sections
All questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with 4 options
Each question has only one correct answer
Each incorrect answer carries -1 mark (negative marking)
Use of calculator is not permitted
Rough work should be done on the space provided in the test booklet
Mark your answers carefully on the OMR sheet
